props.text: Add what you need, when you need it
The core stays small. Themes and modules are separate packages that you install from the admin or upload as a ZIP file.
Pick a group to filter the list. These are examples of what can be added; install them from Admin → Extensions or upload a ZIP.
Accept payments through PayPal at checkout.
Accept payments through Razorpay at checkout.
Let customers collect their orders from your location.
Let several sellers sell in one store.
Let customers rate and review products.
Let customers save products for later.
Collect email sign-ups and send newsletters.
Run time-limited sales on selected products.
Remind customers about items they left in their cart.
Ask visitors for cookie and privacy consent.
More control over page titles, descriptions and search settings.
Add Google Analytics tracking to your store.
Help write product descriptions and page copy with your own AI key.
Themes and modules are plain packages in the extensions folder, so you can write your own.
